whatItIs.statement: A set of checkable buttons where no more than one option can be checked at a time.

whenToUse.statement: Use Radio Group when the user must choose one option from a set of mutually exclusive choices.

howToUse.statement: Compose RadioGroup from RadioGroupItem children, give every item a distinct value, and associate visible labels with item ids.

options.statement: Use disabled on an individual RadioGroupItem to make only that option unavailable.
Use orientation and dir on RadioGroup when keyboard navigation or layout direction needs to be explicit.
